title.en: Finite verification, ternary representations, and exceptions
title.zh: 有限验证、三元素数表示与例外集

description.en: Verify binary Goldbach through one million, turn a ternary major-arc lower bound into a representation, and pass from dyadic exception counts to a cumulative bound.
description.zh: 验证一百万以内的二元哥德巴赫命题，将三元主弧下界转化为素数表示，并由倍增区间内的例外数推出累积上界。
